Stickman Hook is a physics-based arcade mobile game developed by Madbox where players use a grappling hook to swing a character through obstacle-filled levels. 
Objective and Gameplay
Main Goal: Navigate the character from the starting point to the checkered finish line at the end of each stage.
Physics & Momentum: Use gravity, swinging arcs, and bounce pads to clear gaps and build momentum.
Progression: Complete levels to unlock new character skins and tackle increasingly complex obstacle layouts.

Controls
Tap and Hold: Press the screen to shoot the grappling hook and attach to circular anchor points or nubs.
Release: Let go of the screen to launch the character forward in mid-air using accumulated momentum.
